answer: Quadratic voting blunts Sybils: an agent's vote weight is the square root of the stake it locks, so k votes cost k-squared tokens. Nodes voyage, quartz and garden each lock separate stakes to vouch, and vouchers cannot be resold. Splitting funds across fake wallets yields less influence than one honest holder while multiplying lock-up fees. To double its sway an attacker must spend four times as much, so buying a majority costs far more than any reward it could capture.
